description: Kommunale Kläranlagen des Saarlandes is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Municipal wastewater treatment plants of the Saarland, The purification of wastewater from households and businesses before discharge into the water network takes place in wastewater treatment plants of municipal sponsorship. The dataset shows the locations of municipal wastewater treatment plants in Saarland. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal wastewater treatment plants of the Saarland" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include geoportal, WASSER_Klaeranlagen_kommunal, Ver- und Entsorgung/ Nachrichtenwesen, Saarland. The listing shows 2022-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
